title: Unit 1 Pretest: Quantitative Reasoning and Problem Solving

standardsCovered.description: I can use fractions, decimals, and percents to solve real-world money and business problems.
I can use ratios, rates, and proportional relationships to solve real-world money and business problems.
I can calculate and interpret weighted averages using spreadsheets or technology to support decisions.
I can rearrange formulas to isolate meaningful quantities in real-world situations.
I can evaluate function notation and interpret outputs in real-world contexts.
I can calculate and explain average rate of change from tables, graphs, formulas, and contexts.
Embedded mathematical reasoning, quantitative communication, strategy selection, interpretation, and reasonableness.
